summary: The playbook now just lists roles: system_demo. Output prefixes tasks with the role name and shows ok rather than changed since config already matches.
questions: Why do task names show the role name prefix?
Why does my role run show ok instead of changed?

answer_card.title: Call the role from a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: configure cisco routers
  hosts: routers
  connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - system_demo
```
Task names now appear as `system_demo : configure hostname`, which helps when many roles run. It shows `ok` because the config already matches (idempotent).
